info.title: EET Gateway API
info.summary: Sends sales to the Czech EET 2.0 (Finanční správa ČR) with a persistent queue.

tags.name: Queue
tags.description: What is waiting, uncertain or overdue.

post.description: Validates the sale, stores it and sends it to EET. Accepts JSON, XML (`<Data>` or `<Trzba>`) and form fields; field names and formats: docs/INGEST.md.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: `sync` waits for the first attempt; `async` stores the sale, answers 202 and sends it in the background right away.

parameters.name: verify
parameters.description: Verification mode (`overeni`): EET checks the message and registers nothing.

parameters.name: register
parameters.description: Register id; may also come from the input field `register`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeating the request with the same key returns the stored result instead of sending again.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when the sale was already queued and the stored result is returned.

202.description: Not settled yet: `queued` or `uncertain`; poll the Location.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when the sale was already queued and the stored result is returned.

401.description: Missing or wrong API key (`Authorization: Bearer …`).

409.description: Idempotency key already used for another sale.

post.description: Meant for resending after an outage and for migration; sales should be sent as they happen (metodika 1.2). Every row is stored and sent on its own.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: `sync` waits for the first attempt; `async` stores the sale, answers 202 and sends it in the background right away.

parameters.name: verify
parameters.description: Verification mode (`overeni`): EET checks the message and registers nothing.

parameters.name: register
parameters.description: Register id; may also come from the input field `register`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeating the request with the same key never registers a row twice; each row is keyed `<key>:<row>`.

requestBody.description: Sales, one per row. The format follows Content-Type; CSV may be UTF-8 or Windows-1250.

post.description: For `queued`, `uncertain` and `rejected` records (e.g. after fixing the certificate). Always `prvni_zaslani=false` after the first attempt.

409.description: Final record (`not_retryable`), being sent (`in_progress`) or register gone.

parameters.description: Comma-separated: accepted, verification_ok, rejected, queued, uncertain, invalid.

parameters.description: Also check that every EET endpoint is reachable (OPTIONS preflight only).

apiKey.description: An API key from the server configuration (apiKeys, EET_API_KEYS).

id.description: Record id in the queue; absent when nothing was stored.

data.description: The EET `<Data>` stored for the sale; every attempt sends exactly this.

pok.description: Fiscal identification code from EET (accepted only).

code.description: EET error code of the last answer (`kod`).

reason.description: Why the last attempt has no EET answer: timeout, network, interrupted, …

overdue.description: No POK 48 hours after the sale (ZoET §20); absent in verification mode.
